reason: Adds xAI Grok OAuth authentication and model access to DeepSeek Harness, including account model discovery and CLI-based login management.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 xAI Grok 的 OAuth 登录、账户模型选择及通过 xAI 服务进行对话的功能。
summaries.en: Adds xAI Grok OAuth sign-in, account model selection, and access to xAI models within DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: OAuth token storage and automatic refresh
Optional import of existing Grok CLI authentication
Network requests to xAI model and model-listing APIs
Streaming responses, tool calls, and reasoning through the configured LLM service
